data.name: Friendly Firewall
data.detailed_description: Dust off the old flashlight and enter the mainframe! In this horror like game you scavenge batteries and rescue playful clownlings while sneaking, puzzling, and hacking your way through an evil firewall. Collect power to upgrade gadgets, recruit clownling chaos to distract security, and launch a daring raid on the central mainframe to shut down. But beware for unforeseen IT security rooming and destroying all anomalies.
